beta_arch.verdict: ACCEPT_SCIENTIFIC_CANDIDATE_WITH_SCOPED_DETECTION; final authored row still requires independent inspection
beta_arch.identity: The proposed whole strand-connection-strand motif is distinct from a beta hairpin. Two consecutive strands in chain order have no hydrogen-bond pairing with one another. Beta-arc denotes the connection, so it must not be an exact alias for the whole motif. Bare beta-beta remains ambiguous.
beta_arch.hierarchy: proteintraitsmech:SUPER_SECONDARY_MOTIF is an existing, scientifically valid parent. STRUCTURE/STRUCT_SECONDARY is appropriate. No exact SO identifier was established, so native internal-ID governance remains required.

primary_support.inspected: Full retained primary XML: introduction, beta-arch loop analysis methods, dIG8-CC structural characterization, structure deposition/data availability, and license
primary_support.findings: The source distinguishes nonpaired cross-sheet connections from hairpins, analyzes DSSP assignments and strand pairing, and experimentally confirms loop- and helix-containing connections in dIG8-CC. The less-than-nine-residue sampling restriction is not a universal definition.
primary_support.rights: CC-BY-4.0 explicitly verified in the primary article. Attribute the source and identify the project definition as a synthesis.

example.metadata: v1.2, revised 2024-11-13; dIG8-CC synthetic construct; X-ray 2.05 angstrom; chains A/B/C/D, 73-residue entities
example.grounding_verdict: Adequate source-backed representative for this geometric class. The source's structural characterization plus deposition section connects dIG8-CC beta-arches to 7SKO; no inference from a generic protein name alone is needed.
example.caption_conflict: Figure 5c says 7SKP chain C, but source deposition/data-availability sections and archive assign 7SKO/7SKN to dIG8-CC and 7SKP to dIG14. Retain this conflict and use 7SKO without inventing residue bounds or relying on the faulty caption.
example.assembly_caution: Archive biological assemblies are C2 homodimers; the motif is intrachain. Calling individual chain copies monomers must not be turned into a claim that the biological protein is strictly monomeric.
example.qualification: Representative structure only; zero release-pinned QUALIFIED canonical examples. Synthetic construct must remain explicit.

detection.local_tool_check: Read-only mkdssp --version and --help: mkdssp 4.6.1, documented input-file/output-file positional syntax and --output-format=dssp option
detection.review_needed_after_recipe: Locate successive strand segments in a continuous chain; inspect their pairing and coordinate topology. Confirm lack of strand pairing rather than treating missing backbone data or absent DSSP assignments as a negative result. Connections containing a helix are allowed.
detection.claim_limit: The command is runnable secondary-structure/pairing screening, not a standalone beta-arch classifier. This reviewer checked command availability/syntax but did not run a structure or validate motif detection. Preserve an explicit manual classification step; do not call this a tested automatic detector.

precise_actions: Keep the proposed nonpaired-strand definition and existing supersecondary parent.
Keep the 7SKO representative with synthetic-construct and caption-conflict notes; omit unverified residue ranges.
Retain partial screening/manual discrimination scope and report executed versus unexecuted checks precisely.
Complete native ID reservation and inspect the final manifest row before writing.

asx_turn.verdict: DEFER_CURRENT_BATCH_REASONABLE; do not count an unresolved example/detector as completed
asx_turn.identity: SO:0000912 and alt_id BS:00203 are exact. Its three-residue side-chain-O to i+2 backbone-NH motif is distinct from SO:0001106 Asx motif, which spans five residues and requires two hydrogen bonds. Use POLYPEPTIDE_STRUCTURAL_MOTIF as the available broad native parent; current TURN is a DSSP state and should not become its parent by name similarity.
asx_turn.source_support: Official retained SO definition and license verified. Independently inspected Leader and Milner-White 2009 BMC primary resource article: DOI:10.1186/1471-2105-10-60, CC-BY-2.0, hydrogen-bond/dihedral pipeline and source-specific SQL. The article text does not identify 1VJS.
asx_turn.example_assessment: https://motif.gla.ac.uk/ explicitly labels an Asx turn at the active site of alpha-amylase 1VJS. The archive verifies Bacillus licheniformis chain A, v1.3, X-ray 1.7 angstrom. That is a real source assertion, not an inferred sequence hit. However, its website-specific annotation license is unresolved and cannot be inherited from the BMC article. The factual pointer may be retained as a research lead, but parent is justified in requiring a cleared example route before accepting this trait in the current batch.

mdtraj_alternative.status: DOCUMENTED_FUTURE_SCREEN_ONLY; not installed, implemented, or executed
mdtraj_alternative.source_license: LGPL-2.1-or-later, stated in official source header
mdtraj_alternative.function: mdtraj.baker_hubbard(traj, freq=0.0, exclude_water=True, periodic=False, sidechain_only=False, distance_cutoff=0.25, angle_cutoff=120)
mdtraj_alternative.geometry: Hydrogen-to-acceptor distance strictly below 0.25 nm and donor-hydrogen-acceptor angle strictly above 120 degrees. This is a stated screening geometry, not a claim of equivalence to HBPLUS or the published database assignments.
mdtraj_alternative.necessary_class_filter: Require backbone N-H donor at i+2, ASN OD1 or ASP OD1/OD2 acceptor at i, and actual two-peptide-bond continuity in the same chain. Check hydrogen/protonation state, Asn side-chain orientation, alternate conformers, missing atoms and author/insertion numbering. Do not use a D/Nxx pattern or integer residue-label difference alone.
mdtraj_alternative.critical_failure_mode: Official source returns an empty bond array when no donor hydrogens are present. A future wrapper must fail closed on missing protonated topology instead of interpreting zero output as absence of Asx turns.
mdtraj_alternative.completion_gate: A new detector need not be forced into this bounded batch. The documented alternative does not resolve current execution, class-filter validation or representative source-rights gates.
